race.description: Mcphersons Printing Group Vicbred Voucher Trot
race.comment: KEAYANG MINNESOTA (7) added to the impressive sequence of wins last start when she scored by 4 metres over 2160m at Hamilton. The driver has some work to do from this wide starting position. Facing a tougher assignment but she is good enough to cope. GLORIFIED (2) finished 12th last start in a Group One over 2690m at this track, beaten 100 metres by Mister Devereaux. Ideally drawn and can play a big role. BULLAPARK BENO (3) last appeared when sixth over 2150m at Bendigo four-and-a-half months ago. Look out for any positive market movement. SAMMY HALLER (6) is taking on a far easier race this time after finishing ninth in a Group One at his latest appearance over 2240m at Melton, beaten 30 metres by Sam Nien. A big performance is on the cards.
